notes:
SiriusXM knows what it is playing, and albums stop pretending to be radio stations.

SIRIUSXM NAMES ITS CHANNEL. Whether you start it from Sorriva, the Sonos app or Alexa, the zone card now shows the right channel with its artwork and the song playing on it. It reads Unknown only when the channel genuinely is not in your library.

NO MORE CHANNEL NUMBERS. Sonos prefixes its favorites with 'CH 25 - '; the station is just Classic Rewind. The number is gone from the library and every screen. Sonos keeps its own naming in its own app.

COVER ART FOR EVERY SERVICE THAT HAS IT. SiriusXM publishes a cover per song and Sorriva was throwing it away — the way each service reports its song and its artwork is now described per service instead of forced into one shape.

ALBUMS AND PLAYLISTS ARE TOLD APART. Sonos always said which was which and Sorriva ignored it, so everything imported was a 'station'. Playlists now have their own place in the library rather than being buried in Radio, and the setup screen tells you whether you are adding an album or a playlist.

LAUNCHING NO LONGER RESTARTS ITSELF. The app wrongly believed the network had just come back every time it started, and threw away the speaker checking it had only just begun. That was the setup for the freeze where every zone stops updating until you relaunch.

NOT IN THIS RELEASE: albums imported from a service still appear under Radio rather than with your albums. They have no track listing yet, which is the next piece of work — and the reason they are visibly in the wrong place rather than quietly missing.
